# soupmix/cache

> 标签: adapters, apcu, array, cache, memcached, redis, simplecache

## 简介

Provides framework agnostic implementation of PSR-16 Simple Cache Interface

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 8；已收录于 php-v8。

- 官网：https://github.com/soupmix/cache
- 源码仓库：https://github.com/soupmix/cache.git
- Packagist 页面：https://packagist.org/packages/soupmix%2Fcache
